host_in_sqm_alarm_threshold.description: SQM degraded alarm threshold for HostIn receive lane <lane>.

host_in_target_sqm.description: Target SQM for HostIn receive lane <lane>; a U8 value of s encodes the SQM value 10 + s/10. Mirrored ingress-management register (relevant for host visibility, not for the module).

ingress_lt_enabled_lane.description: When link training is enabled on lane <lane>, the procedure selected by IngressLTProtocolLane<lane> is executed. Mirrored ingress-management register.

ingress_lt_protocol_lane.description: Link training protocol/procedure used when link training is enabled on ingress lane <lane>.

ingress_lt_retries_lane.description: Maximum number of retries after which the controlling link training entity terminates the session on ingress lane <lane>.

ingress_lt_timeout_lane.description: Maximum duration after which the controlling link training entity times out and terminates the session on ingress lane <lane>.

mod_hsout_ffe_cursor_location.description: FFE cursor location L of ModHsOut lane <lane>, encoded as L = [register] + 1.

mod_hsout_ffe_length.description: FFE length N of ModHsOut lane <lane>, encoded as N = [register] + 1.

mod_hsout_invoke_load_preset_trig.description: Preset configuration change request per lane: 0: no preset configuration change on lane <lane>, 1: preset configuration change on lane <lane>; requested preset in ModHsOut<lane>PresetRequested. H2M message bit, self-clearing.

mod_hsout_invoke_set_pattern_trig.description: Pattern configuration change request per lane: 0: no pattern configuration change for lane <lane>, 1: pattern configuration change for lane <lane>; requested pattern in ModHsOut<lane>PatternRequested. H2M message bit, self-clearing.

mod_hsout_invoke_set_precoder_trig.description: Precoder configuration change request per lane: 0: no precoder configuration change for lane <lane>, 1: precoder configuration change for lane <lane>; request in ModHsOut<lane>PrecoderConfigured. H2M message bit, self-clearing.

mod_hsout_load_preset_completed_flag.description: The module notifies the host about completion of a preset configuration procedure (with or without success). M2H message bit, clear on read.

mod_hsout_out_tuning_step.description: Nominal p-p differential amplitude step size for ModHsOut lane <lane>; reported amplitude values have only 50 mV resolution.

mod_hsout_pattern_configured.description: Configured pattern of ModHsOut on lane <lane> after the last change; maintained by the module responder.

mod_hsout_pattern_requested.description: (Desired) pattern for ModHsOut on lane <lane>, written by the host requester engine.

mod_hsout_precoder_configured.description: Actual precoder configuration status maintained by the module: 0: precoder off, 1: precoder on. The module must keep this register current with the actual precoder configuration.

mod_hsout_precoder_requested.description: 0: precoder off for lane <lane>, 1: precoder on for lane <lane>. The precoder is of type 1/(1+D) mod 4 as defined in IEEE 802.3 clause 135.5.7.2.

mod_hsout_preset_configured.description: Identifier of the actual ModHsOut preset loaded on lane <lane> in response to a request.

mod_hsout_preset_requested.description: Requested preset configuration for ModHsOut lane <lane>; the module does not return failure when a preset is not supported.

mod_hsout_set_pattern_completed_flag.description: The module notifies the host about completion of a pattern configuration procedure (with or without success). The host clears the bits fetched and optionally compares actual and requested configuration. M2H message bit, clear on read.

mod_hsout_set_pattern_completed_mask.description: Mask bits for the ModHsOut<lane>SetPatternCompletedFlag (page 52h byte 246). 1 (default): interrupt generation disabled, 0: interrupt generation enabled (unmasked).

mod_hsout_set_precoder_completed_flag.description: The module notifies the host about completion of a precoder configuration procedure (with or without success). The parsed description text names HostOut<lane>PrecoderSettingCompletedTrig; the register lives on the ingress map at byte 248 (see namespace README). M2H message bit, clear on read.

mod_hsout_set_precoder_completed_mask.description: Mask bits for the ModHsOut<lane>SetPrecoderCompletedFlag (page 52h byte 248). 1 (default): interrupt generation disabled, 0: interrupt generation enabled (unmasked).

mod_hsout_set_preset_completed_mask.description: Mask bits for the ModHsOut<lane>LoadPresetCompletedFlag (page 52h byte 247). 1 (default): interrupt generation disabled, 0: interrupt generation enabled (unmasked).

mod_hsout_set_sqm_alarm_thr_completed_ma.description: Mask bits for the corresponding SQM alarm threshold procedure completion Flag; no matching Flag register is recorded in the parsed OIF-CMIS-LT-01.0 map (see namespace README). 1 (default): interrupt generation disabled, 0: interrupt generation enabled (unmasked).

mod_hsout_set_sqm_target_completed_mask.description: Mask bits for the corresponding SQM target procedure completion Flag; no matching Flag register is recorded in the parsed OIF-CMIS-LT-01.0 map (see namespace README). 1 (default): interrupt generation disabled, 0: interrupt generation enabled (unmasked).

mod_hsout_tap_tuning_step.description: ModHsOut transmit FFE tap tuning step size; reported tap values have only 0.01 resolution.

mod_hsout_training_result.description: Ingress link training diagnostic failure codes per lane; reset to 00b when a new link training is started.

mod_hsout_training_status.description: Status of ingress link training per lane, reported by the host; meaningful only when host visibility is enabled.

mod_hsout_tuning_completed_mask.description: Mask bits for the ModHsOut<lane>TuningCompletedFlag (page 53h byte 227). 1 (default): interrupt generation disabled, 0: interrupt generation enabled (unmasked).

reserved_249_255.description: Reserved bytes 249-255 (Table 64 lists the row as Reserved with an unexplained RO/COR Adv. type marking in the parsed spec, which is not recorded as a field here).

reserved_mod_hsout_ffe_cursor_bits_7_3.description: Reserved bits 7-3 of the ModHsOut FfeCursorLocation byte (same parsed-table gap as the FfeLength byte).

reserved_mod_hsout_ffe_length_bits_7_3.description: Reserved bits 7-3 of the ModHsOut FfeLength byte. The parsed table lists bits 7-4 as reserved next to the 2-0 field, leaving bit 3 unassigned; reserved is modeled as bits 7-3.
